notes: Baseline seeded manually on 2026-10-21 (first state file for this contract). ath.price_usd is the true all-time high (CoinGecko, 2026-05-28), not the tracking-start price, so the ATH gate cannot false-fire until the token genuinely exceeds it. Targets pre-registered from aeon.yml var so a crossing between runs is caught rather than swallowed by the skill's first-observation rule. h1_pct is stored as null when no trade occurred in the window (DexScreener omits h1 rather than printing 0) - do not read null as 'flat'. CLASSIFYING BUYS, five tells: (1) a single-venue print from a wallet that KEEPS the balance is directional; (2) a same-block sweep of 4-5 pools into one hop then forwarded to a shared sink that ends at 0 balance is arb/aggregator; (3) the SAME sender buying in one pool and selling in another within the same second is a two-leg arb - apply this to SELLS too, since at 16:01Z all 8 'sells' were mirrored same-second buys on the USDC pool and directional flow was zero; (4) a wallet whose eth_getCode starts 0xef0100 is an EIP-7702 delegated smart account, not a fresh bot EOA - check the designator; (5) buy/sell COUNT is not buy/sell DOLLARS on a thin book. Always balanceOf the receiver before calling an uptick accumulation - encode balanceOf calldata as selector + 24 hex zeros + the 40-hex address (74 hex chars), never zero-pad the address on the right. RPC NOTE: base.gateway.tenderly.co now rejects eth_getLogs ranges over 1000 blocks for anonymous callers - chunk at 999 and retry with backoff rather than reading the rejection as an empty result (a zero-log read without a control check is the documented trap). Verify a one-clip 'wave' by its FOLLOW-THROUGH: at 15:05Z a $4.3k buy looked like the start of something; by 16:01Z volume was back to $145/hr and the buyer's nonce had not moved, so it was one clip, not a wave.
